title: Walk-in || Logistics Coordinator
description:
Time and Venue:
Interview Date: 04 Oct - 08 Oct
Timing: 10.00 AM - 6.00 PM
Venue: Cygnus Solutions - Address: Sri Ram Building, Malemar, Chowki, Kottara, Mangaluru, Karnataka 575006
Contact: Recruiter Cygnus Solutions (9740539861)

Logistics Coordinator Sea & Air Freight Company: Cygnus Solutions
 Work Location: Mangalore, Karnataka
 Head Office: KSA (Kingdom of Saudi Arabia)
 Experience: 2–3 Years
 Employment Type: Full-time
 Working Days: 5 Days a Week About the Company Cygnus Solutions is a recruitment and business support organization associated with operations supporting an established industrial group headquartered in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The group operates across industrial, construction, oil & gas, petrochemical, engineering, and related sectors in the Middle East. Job Overview We are looking for a Logistics Coordinator – Sea & Air Freight to manage and coordinate international shipments through ocean and air freight. The role involves coordinating with freight forwarders, shipping lines, airlines, customs, warehouses, and internal teams to ensure shipments are delivered efficiently, on time, and in compliance with international trade requirements. Key Responsibilities Coordinate and manage sea and air freight shipments from booking through final delivery. Book cargo with shipping lines, airlines, freight forwarders, and logistics service providers. Track shipments and provide timely updates on shipment status, ETAs, and delivery schedules. Prepare, verify, and maintain shipping and export/import documentation, including:
 Commercial Invoices Packing Lists Bills of Lading Air Waybills Customs documentation Coordinate with freight forwarders, carriers, customs agents, warehouses, and clients. Ensure shipments comply with applicable international trade and customs requirements. Handle shipment delays, route deviations, documentation issues, cargo damage, and other logistics-related challenges. Coordinate with internal departments to ensure shipments meet required delivery timelines. Maintain accurate shipment records and update logistics systems/software. Manage multiple shipments and priorities in a fast-paced logistics environment. Required Skills & Qualifications 2–3 years of relevant experience in ocean and air freight forwarding, international logistics, or shipping. Good understanding of Incoterms and international shipping procedures. Knowledge of IATA regulations and/or IMDG regulations is preferred. Strong communication and coordination skills. Good organizational and documentation skills. Ability to track and manage multiple shipments simultaneously. Strong problem-solving and follow-up skills. Proficiency in logistics software, ERP systems, or shipment tracking platforms. Ability to work effectively under pressure and meet strict delivery timelines. Knowledge of customs and import/export procedures will be an advantage. Bilingual/multilingual skills will be an added advantage. Relevant certifications in hazardous materials, international trade, or logistics will be an advantage.

Key Skills: Air Freight,SEA Freight,Import Logistics,Export,Oil and Gas,Export Logistics,SEA,Logistics coordination
